[SWS_PER_00532]
⌈
ara::per::ReadWriteAccessor::SetFileSize
shall set the file size to the provided value. The read/write position shall be set to the
end of the file if the current position is higher than the new file size. If the provided
value is larger than the current file size, ara::per::ReadWriteAccessor::-
SetFileSize shall return kInvalidSize.
⌋
